explanation: DJ Kool Herc, who was born in Jamaica, stretched the drum breaks of funk records by switching between turntables. MCs rapped over the breaks, and the dancers became b-boys.

claims.text: Hip hop emerged from block parties in the Bronx, New York City.
Hip hop did not originate in Brooklyn, Queens or Manhattan.
DJ Kool Herc, born in Jamaica, extended the drum breaks of funk records by switching between turntables at Bronx parties.
MCs rapped over the extended breaks, and the dancers who danced to them became known as b-boys.
